configuration.title: DITA Viewer
config.customCss.description: Custom CSS file paths to apply to the preview. Supports absolute paths, paths relative to workspace root, and paths relative to the DITA file directory.
config.cssDirectory.description: Directories to scan for available CSS files. Supports absolute paths, workspace-relative paths, and document-relative paths. CSS files found here appear in the preview theme dropdown.
config.ditaOtPath.description: Absolute path to the DITA-OT installation directory (should contain bin/dita or bin\dita.bat). Leave empty to auto-detect via the DITA_HOME environment variable and PATH.
config.ditaOtInjectNavToolbar.descriptio: (Deprecated) Inject site-enhancement features (navigation, sidebar, etc.) after transform. Newer versions use a QuickPick during the transform flow to choose specific features instead; this setting is kept only for backward compatibility.
